cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

mechanism: A confidently plans to tell the children about an operation, repeatedly adjusting rehearsal so B stays until A can begin the real conversation alone.
confusable: Unlike simply postponing goodbye, A needs steadiness for a specified next task; borrowed authority negotiates a smaller rehearsal around B departure.
comparison: A hospital conversation with children differs from tolerating a newly empty home after a move.
seedUse: Use D98-a tea/children/operation/rehearsal/taxi and S02-a shortening a managed sequence to fit the helper.
